package.description: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Web GUI 封装成桌面应用的 Electron 客户端。

en-US.description: An Electron desktop client that wraps the local DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
en-US.longDescription: dsh-desktop wraps the local DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (default http://127.0.0.1:3080) into an Electron desktop application so it can be launched by double-click and run in its own window like standalone software, with a fully custom seamless title bar, system tray, automatic service startup with port-conflict fallback, and automatic DeepSeek Harness dependency installation.

zh-CN.description: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Web GUI 封装成桌面应用的 Electron 客户端。
zh-CN.longDescription: dsh-desktop 把 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Web GUI（默认 http://127.0.0.1:3080）封装成一个 Electron 桌面应用，让它可以像独立软件一样双击启动、独立窗口运行。提供全自绘无缝标题栏、托盘常驻、服务自动启动与端口冲突自动换端口、安装包自动检测并安装 DeepSeek Harness 依赖等功能。
zh-CN.name: DeepSeek Harness
